name: Ayanokouji Aya
source:
The only daughter of the Ayanokouji Zaibatsu, a large zaibatsu that has made a name for itself around the world. 

According to the Ayanokouji family tradition, she must have a groom and take over the zaibatsu at the age of 18, However, she runs away because she doesn't like her arranged marriage and meets Yamato, who awakens her to true love.

Naturally, she is naive, and truly believes that storks bring deliver babies from the cabbage fields.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=532785]Getchu[/url]]
